en.title: Minimum Total Cost of Prefix Adjustments
en.description:
Choose any non-empty prefix and add an integer x to all of it, at a cost of |x|; find the minimum total cost to make all elements equal. The final common value is not specified.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n integers. The original gives no numeric ranges; this site adds 1≤n≤200000, −1000000000≤a[i]≤1000000000.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 6; 0; 8. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: The answer is the sum of the absolute differences between adjacent elements.
